title: Bounded static residualization
requirement: WHEN a reference step is specialized, the specializer SHALL produce bounded ResidualStepIR preserving every dynamic reference boundary.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Three realization masks
scenarios.when: Empty, fixed-family or fixed-ProgramImage static bindings are applied to the same reference step.
scenarios.then: Only immutable code/declarations/layout facts are folded; runtime control, data, environments, frames, fuel/work, capacity checks and outcomes remain dynamic. A finite worklist and residual-size limit fall back to generic dispatch without application exhaustion. Recursion remains runtime calls, with no depth/fuel/local-value specialization or source recursion unrolling; rule/source-occurrence maps retain intermediate stops and charges in universal, family and per-program realizations.

expected.worklist/size limit: falls back to generic dispatch without application exhaustion

scenarios.judgment: Evaluator reading (UIREQ-033 + interfaces.md 'Bounded static residualization' + demonstrators D33): the reference step is the K-A stepReference published by --reference-slices. A residual realization must cover every reference rule the program exercises and, when executed, reproduce the reference StepRecord stream (rules, charges, frame checks, stops) exactly, including exact-fuel, fuel-1 and stack-1 runs, under the universal (empty mask), each fixed family and the per-program mask. A residual over a hand-written rule table is a gap report and fails.
unasserted: the exact block granularity and layout_version value
source-occurrence map contents beyond non-emptiness for per-program (K control strings carry runtime values, so no independent occurrence key exists)
which static facts a family folds beyond layout+family
